scenario: [LTIM.2.6.2]: the compiler counts `t.local(tz)` as a zone read unless `tz` folds to `"UTC"`: a literal, or a `const` whose folded value it is ([LGRA.4.1]). `HOME` is such a `const`, so `e.fired.local(HOME)` resolves no zone ([LTIM.10.8]), the `where` is not time-dependent ([LTIM.2.4.1]), and the two-pattern rule compiles. `compile_ok`. PATH: `dsc.validate.ltim_2_6_2_clock_where`'s `time_read`, whose zone arm is `dsc.typecheck.ltim_2_4_1_zone_read`, which folds the zone with `dsc.dstest.ltsl_4_1_string_constant`. A zone arm that exempts only a literal `"UTC"` refuses this rule with DS_VALIDATE_NOW_MULTIPATTERN_UNSUPPORTED. The twin of LTIM.2.6.2_zone_read_multipattern_rejects.
rules_ds:
use default

const HOME = "UTC"

schema Arm scope logical:
    k: Int key

schema Event scope logical:
    k: Int key
    fired: Time mutable

rule office_hours:
    Arm a
    Event e where e.k == a.k and e.fired.local(HOME).hour > 8
->
    log info "in hours"
